title: Pronunciation Dictionary v1
description: Repo-held, versioned pronunciation rules synced to ElevenLabs. Accretive: each episode's corrections are inherited by every later episode. Phoneme rules are silently ignored by models other than eleven_flash_v2 and eleven_v3, so the model is declared here and unusable rules are rejected at authoring time.

model_id.description: The TTS model these rules will be used with. eleven_multilingual_v2 skips phoneme tags entirely.

note.description: Why this rule exists — which episode surfaced the mispronunciation.

dictionary_id.description: ElevenLabs dictionary id, returned on first sync.

synced_rules_hash.description: Hash of the rules at last successful sync. Sync is a no-op while this matches.
